errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled "килограми от хектар" (kilograms per hectare), not "хиляди хектари" (thousands of hectares).
The y-axis labels are at intervals of 500 (e.g., 3500, 4000, 4500), not 100.
The description fails to identify which line represents which type of grape (wine grapes vs. dessert grapes) as indicated in the legend.

errors.text_span: пунктирана, с маркери във формата на кръг
errors.evidence: The blue line is solid, not dotted/dashed ("пунктирана"), and has no markers.
The value for the blue line in 2016 is approximately 5800, not 4900.

errors.text_span: В периода от 2021 до 2022 година линията се стабилизира на ниво 5700.
errors.evidence: The blue line does not stabilize; it rises to approximately 6250 in 2021 and then falls to approximately 5600 in 2022. The value 5700 is incorrect for both years.

errors.text_span: с маркери във формата на триъгълник
errors.evidence: The orange line is solid and has no markers.
The starting value for the orange line in 2014 is approximately 4400, not 4800.
The peak value for the orange line in 2015 is much higher, at approximately 7250, not 6900.
The value for the orange line in 2016 is exactly 5000, not 5500.
The value for the orange line in 2017 is approximately 6750, not 6200.

errors.text_span: За периода 2020 — 2022 линията показва тенденция на покачване
errors.evidence: The orange line does not show a consistent upward trend from 2020 to 2022. It rises from 2020 to 2021 and then falls from 2021 to 2022.
The value for the orange line in 2022 is approximately 6150, not 6500.
